model.title: Combating Foreign Threats to Main Street Act of 2026
model.meta: Small Business Committee · Rep. Roger Williams (R-TX)

summary.text: The bill would require the Small Business Administration to share information with small businesses about harmful activities by foreign adversaries, helping them understand and protect themselves against foreign threats to their operations.
